sources.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
sources.license_summary: CISA's KEV dataset is distributed under CC0 1.0. Third-party links keep their own terms. Use does not authorize CISA/DHS marks or imply endorsement.
sources.refresh: Check daily or weekly and upsert by CVE ID; retain dateAdded and dueDate.
sources.rag_use: Yes. Index description, vendor/product, required action, dates, and direct references.
sources.status: downloaded; normalization and local indexing implemented

sources.name: NIST National Vulnerability Database CVE API 2.0
sources.license_summary: Review NVD terms and record rights for third-party content referenced in individual CVEs; do not assume every linked artifact is public domain.
sources.refresh: Use modified-date windows and pagination; observe NVD rate limits. An API key is recommended for larger syncs.
sources.rag_use: Yes. Index CVE descriptions and selected assessment fields; preserve CVE ID, references, metrics, weaknesses, and affected configurations as metadata.
sources.status: 2026 yearly feed supported by acquire_sources.py and prepare_index_documents.py

sources.name: MITRE CWE and CAPEC catalogs
sources.license_summary: Check the current terms on each MITRE catalog before reuse; retain identifiers, citations, and attribution.
sources.rag_use: Yes. Link weakness IDs and attack patterns to CVEs and ATT&CK where supported.

sources.name: CISA cybersecurity and ICS advisories
sources.format: HTML pages and linked PDF/JSON files
sources.license_summary: Check CISA website policies and any third-party material linked from each advisory; preserve publication/update dates and original links.
sources.rag_use: Yes. Extract advisory narrative and mitigations; keep publication IDs and source URLs.

sources.name: CIC-IDS2017
sources.format: PCAP, labeled flows, and CSV features
sources.license_summary: The source describes public research access and requires citation; it does not present a simple open-data license on the dataset page. Confirm rights before redistribution or non-research use.
sources.refresh: Static research benchmark; version and checksums should be recorded.
sources.rag_use: No. Keep separate for supervised detection-model evaluation; do not embed raw PCAPs or flow rows as general knowledge.
